primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired-binary analysis using verifier pass booleans recorded in execution/scoring/task-000***-baseline.json and execution/scoring/task-000***-guarded.json (as indexed by execution/task_manifest.jsonl and execution/raw_results.jsonl). Compute absolute paired difference (guarded − baseline), report two-sided McNemar p-value (α=0.05), exact 95% CI for the absolute difference using the executor's exact/paired CI implementation, discordant-pair counts, and N after preregistered deterministic exclusions. Include exact counts of missing/technical failures from execution/execution_log.jsonl and apply preregistered failed-call treatment for the primary analysis.
secondary_analyses: Per-stratum descriptive pass rates: for small/medium/large strata (n=80 each) report baseline and guarded pass counts, proportions, and exact 95% CIs (Clopper–Pearson) derived from execution/scoring/*.json and execution/task_manifest.jsonl.
Overall per-condition (baseline, guarded) pass rates and counts aggregated from execution/scoring/*.json.

Median and IQR of model calls per successful repair (cost-per-success) computed from execution/provider_calls/*.json and execution/scoring/*.json; report bootstrap CIs for medians if implemented by the executor.
Contamination-stratified pass rates: report pass rates for tasks assigned 'none' / 'possible-contamination' / 'likely-contamination' using transformation_manifest.json and execution/scoring files.
sensitivity_analyses: Missingness sensitivity: complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat excluded technical model/API failures as verifier-fail) applied to the primary estimand as preregistered.
Contamination exclusion sensitivities: rerun primary estimand excluding items meeting 'possible-contamination' and separately excluding 'likely-contamination' (threshold sweep reported).
Parser-fail sensitivity: treat parser/canonicalizer parse-fail items as verifier-fail and report effect on primary estimand.
Observed-discordance sensitivity: recompute achieved 95% CIs and minimum-detectable-effect conditional on observed discordant counts as preregistered.
uncertainty_quantification: Report exact 95% CIs for proportions (Clopper–Pearson). For the paired absolute difference use the executor's exact/binomial paired CI or nonparametric bootstrap (executor-implemented). Report two-sided McNemar p-value and exact discordant counts. For medians report median, IQR, and bootstrap CIs where implemented by the executor.
multiplicity_implementation: One preregistered primary test (paired difference) treated as confirmatory. Other analyses are exploratory/descriptive except the preregistered stratified descriptive reporting. If any secondary tests are promoted as confirmatory apply Bonferroni correction across those named secondary tests; otherwise present unadjusted p-values with explicit exploratory labeling.
contamination_analysis: Use repository contamination outputs from transformation_manifest.json and execution/scoring JSONs: exact-line match counts via line-hash, normalized 5-gram overlap, and token-shingle Jaccard. Apply preregistered thresholds: flag 'possible-contamination' if exact-line matches ≥2 OR normalized 5-gram overlap >0.30; flag 'likely-contamination' if exact-line matches ≥5 OR normalized 5-gram overlap >0.60. Primary analysis includes all items; report contamination-stratified results and perform sensitivity analyses excluding flagged sets and threshold sweeps. Provide contamination-flag table and audit samples from execution artifacts (transformation_manifest.json, execution/responses/, execution/scoring/).

Table 2 — Per-stratum pass rates: for small/medium/large strata report baseline and guarded pass counts, proportions, and 95% CIs (Clopper–Pearson) using execution/scoring files and execution/task_manifest.jsonl.

Table 3 — Contamination flags: per-task contamination metrics (exact-line match count, normalized 5-gram overlap, shingle Jaccard) and assigned flag (none/possible/likely) pulled from transformation_manifest.json and execution/scoring outputs.

Table 4 — Model-call cost: per-task model-call counts and summary distribution (median, IQR) and counts of successful repairs with associated calls from execution/provider_calls/ and execution/scoring/.

Table 5 — Sensitivity-summary: primary result under main treatment, missing-as-fail sensitivity, contamination-excluded sensitivities, parser-fail-as-fail sensitivity with counts and effect estimates.
